spanish: Dos manos a la tabla la una, ensambladas una a una; así hizo a todas las tablas del tabernáculo.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration "mishkán" (H4908, definite article + singular common noun) with the Spanish common noun "tabernáculo", matching the established rendering of the identical construction elsewhere (cf. "tablas del tabernáculo").
